checks.rule: Each foreground signal restores a visible paused stage
checks.input: For pageshow, focus and resume: hide stage, then restore document visibility without visibilitychange and emit the signal.
checks.expected: Input becomes enabled and focused for every signal.

checks.rule: Foreground layout is rechecked after its first empty bounds
checks.input: Hide, return while stage bounds are zero, restore real bounds before the queued animation frame.
checks.expected: Initial input is disabled; the next frame enables the visible stage.

checks.rule: A fresh stage touch can recover missed operating-system resume signals
checks.input: Pause through pagehide; deliver a pointerdown on the visible stage without pageshow/focus.
checks.expected: Input is enabled before the event reaches the controls.

checks.rule: Hidden, offscreen and empty stages cannot be enabled by foreground signals
checks.input: Try pageshow/focus/touch with document hidden, stage behind header, below viewport or zero-size.
checks.expected: Input remains disabled in all cases.

checks.rule: Leaving or freezing cancels pending foreground work immediately
checks.input: Queue a resume frame, then pagehide/freeze, and attempt to flush old callbacks or resize.
checks.expected: Stage stays paused until a new valid foreground/touch signal.

checks.rule: Viewport changes and scrolling re-evaluate current bounds rather than stale observer snapshots
checks.input: Move stage offscreen and notify observer; return it, then resize the visual viewport.
checks.expected: Offscreen pauses and visible layout resumes without a document visibility event.

checks.rule: Disposed activity handlers cannot reactivate a removed page
checks.input: Dispose with a queued layout check, then emit every resume/resize/touch event.
checks.expected: Observer is disconnected, pending callbacks cancelled, input remains disabled.
